scope: Complete static medium-fi exterior of the seven-tier gate tower, including both passage facades, eight lower attached columns, small north/south stair doors, round vent indications, three square terraces, two octagonal chambers, eight-sided brick tent, upper watch chamber and long green spire with apple and crescent. Original detailed source remains reproducible. The lower envelope follows the attributed OSM outline, while the architectural field study supplies the 6.90 m passage; the previous sqrt(140) square shaft is preserved only in the original draft. Museum Russian and English pages report different base areas (140 and 147 m²); neither defines whether the passage or projections are counted, so these values do not certify the reconstructed rectangular dimensions. Upper widths, window heights, decorative panels and the tapered north reinforcement are proportional interpretations of exterior photography and published descriptions, not a measured restoration survey. The 1.98 m NE lean is a linear exterior shear. Gate bars and sun/crescent motifs are simplified; mythological figures, individual brick damage, inscriptions, interiors, foundations and adjacent independent palace gates are outside this static exterior scope. Four tiny tent vents are closed dark geometric indications, not openings into an interior. The canonical normally restored crescent is retained despite its temporary removal announced 6 October 2026. No downloaded reference mesh or photograph is embedded or redistributed. Two common material graphs supply brick and painted metal; the small gilded ornaments use a warm stylized tint. Physical phone/laptop timings and host terrain contact remain unmeasured.
